# Lifespan timeline of presidents of Russia__disambig_1

This is a graphical lifespan timeline of presidents of Russia.  The presidents are listed in order of office.
ImageSize  = width:$width height:$height
PlotArea   = right:10 left:1 bottom:80 top:60
Period     = from:$start till:$end
TimeAxis   = orientation:horizontal
Legend = orientation:vertical position:bottom columns:1
Colors =
id:bg              value:white
id:lightline       value:rgb(0.9, 0.9, 0.9)
id:lighttext       value:rgb(0.5, 0.5, 0.5)
id:LIFESPAN        value:rgb(0.88, 0.90, 0.70) Legend: Lifespan
id:NONP            value:rgb(0.7, 0.7, 0.7) Legend: Nonpartisan
id:UNITY           value:rgb(0.13, 0.5, 0.81) Legend: Unity
id:UR              value:rgb(0.18, 0.31, 0.64) Legend: United_Russia
id:NAME            value:rgb(0.15, 0.13, 0.05)
id:TODAY           value:lightpurple
BackgroundColors = canvas:bg
ScaleMinor = gridcolor:lightline unit:year increment:1 start:$start
ScaleMajor = gridcolor:lighttext unit:year increment:10 start:1930
Define $dy = -5 # shift text to button side of bar
LineData=
at:$now color:TODAY width:0.1
PlotData=
bar:1 width:18
color:LIFESPAN align:center fontsize:M
from:1931.2 till:1991 shift:(-0,$dy) textcolor:NAME text:Boris Yeltsin
color:NONP
from:1991 till:1999
color:LIFESPAN
from:1999 till:2007.4
bar:2 width:18
color:LIFESPAN align:center fontsize:M
from:1952 till:1999 shift:(-0,$dy) textcolor:NAME text:Vladimir Putin
color:UNITY
from:1999 till:2001
color:NONP
from:2001 till:2008
color:LIFESPAN
from:2008 till:2012
color:UR
from:2012 till:2012.4
color:NONP
from:2012.4 till:$now
bar:3 width:18
color:LIFESPAN align:center fontsize:M
from:1965 till:2008 shift:(-0,$dy) textcolor:NAME text:Dmitry Medvedev
color:NONP
from:2008 till:2011
color:UR
from:2011 till:2012
color:LIFESPAN
from:2012 till:$now
TextData =
fontsize:M
textcolor:red
pos:($warning,30)
text:Updated
TextData =
pos:(160,$height)
fontsize:L
textcolor:black
text:"Lifespan of each Russian President"
}}
